items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: I'd play, uh, saxophone solos, just for the piano, you see. The technical things, and Rudy Weedhoff, and all that stuff

ctx.x: What I tried to do was to, uh, make a thorough study of music. I wasn't too particularly interested in jazz. I wanted to be a classical musician. When I was about fifteen or sixteen, I had a radio program on WWL. Once or twice a week, and I'd play, uh, saxophone solos, just for the piano, you see. The technical things, and Rudy Weedhoff, and all that stuff, Andy Sonniler, and that. And Al Gallador and I became friends, and he's a very proficient musician, and a master of his own. That's one of the times they had…
Tell me now about your uncle.
